chunks: Buy, even if it is expensive, for indeed sustenance descends with purchasing.

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: al-Sadiq, Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about buying goods when prices are expensive?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام encourages engaging in purchase even when prices are high, linking commercial activity with the coming of rizq. The hadith conveys an ethical outlook of confidence in Allah's provision and discourages excessive hesitation in lawful buying.
